decisions.decision: Move the inline two step warning from @submit to the Save button click, then dispatch confirm-password from the same handler
decisions.why: requestSubmit fires submit but not click, so a card on click with the warning on submit puts the card first (breaks FR-007), and a submit interceptor loops
decisions.rejected: A pass-through flag the card sets before resubmitting

decisions.decision: x-modal.warning gains a confirmsPassword prop that closes the warning and dispatches confirm-password with its form
decisions.why: The teleported warning holds x-trap.inert, so the card would be inert behind it; one dialog at a time keeps the warning first

decisions.decision: x-modal.confirm-password gains a description prop defaulting to the sign-in sentence
decisions.why: FR-006 admin wording while security and profile keep their text
decisions.rejected: A slot or a purpose enum

decisions.decision: ConfigurationViewModel and FlagsViewModel take the User and expose credentials(); the card is placed per screen
decisions.rejected: Including the card in the admin layout

decisions.why: Constitution XI: no data is added and the plan Interface table carries the contract
decisions.rejected: Writing both from the dispatch briefs

decisions.decision: x-delete-action declares its own confirmsPassword prop
decisions.why: a kebab key forwarded only through $attributes lands as ${confirms-password}, never $confirmsPassword, so the warning never saw it
decisions.rejected: forwarding through $attributes as the plan said

decisions.decision: bare x-data on the admin forms whose Save or Register dispatches
decisions.why: the admin layout has no Alpine root, so @click handlers outside a component never start
decisions.rejected: adding x-data to layouts/admin.blade.php, which changes every admin screen

plan.summary: Plan reuses x-modal.confirm-password on the seven gated admin actions with two component props and no server or JavaScript change
plan.key_finding: The card resubmits with requestSubmit(), which fires submit but not click, so the existing @submit warnings would come after the card unless they move to the click handler
